commit_message: feat: add interval merging with property tests
summary: Interval merge with two 500-iteration property tests that look rigorous, but the generator never produces overlapping or touching spans (spans sit in separate 10-wide slots), and the properties never check that the output covers the same points as the input.

defects.description: The generator places span i in [10i, 10i+8), so generated spans never overlap or touch and never arrive out of order; the merge branch is exercised only by the single `merges_overlapping_pair` example. Touching spans (`s.start <= last.end` -> `<`) and unsorted input (dropping `spans.sort()`) survive. The generator needs overlapping, touching, nested and unsorted spans.

Neither property checks that the merged output covers exactly the same integers as the input (only sortedness/disjointness and length), so a merge that drops spans, or `last.end.max(s.end)` -> `s.end` (shrinking a span when a nested one follows), passes. A property should compare the set of covered points (or total length) of input and output.
The generator always produces end > start, so the `retain(|s| s.start < s.end)` filter for empty/inverted spans is never exercised; `<` -> `<=` or removing the retain survives.
